snippet.title: Heroes of Anirea ⚔️ Kickstarter Announcement Trailer | Roguelite Tactical Pixel Art RPG
snippet.description:
Heroes of Anirea is a turn-based tactical JRPG with roguelite progression and character-driven strategy. Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes, each with their own unique skillset, and discover their stories as you face new challenges in a beautifully handcrafted pixel art world.

🟢 Follow on Kickstarter to be the first to know when it goes live: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crossbros/heroes-of-anirea
🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783410/Heroes_of_Anirea/

#indiegames #videogames #jrpg #roguelite #pixelart #fantasy #strategygame
